domain: Financial post-trade settlement platform executing overnight batch processing.

glossary.definition: Group responsible for monitoring and resolving issues in the post-trade workflow.
Automated overnight process that finalises and records all pending transactions from the trading day.
Summary document generated at the end of each settlement batch run, listing total transactions processed, count of exceptions, and batch execution duration.

business_rules.rule: The operations team must be notified via the incident management platform within 15 minutes of batch completion; the notification must include the batch completion report as an attachment, and unacknowledged alerts must be re-sent every 30 minutes until acknowledged.
